municion-incendiaria.efecto: Firearms damage against Kindred is aggravated instead of superficial. Each hit forces a Terror Frenzy test (Difficulty 2).

linterna-uv.efecto: A Kindred caught directly in the beam takes 1 aggravated damage per turn and −2 dice to all actions. Fortitude (Defy Bane) reduces the damage.

iluminado-uv.efecto: A Kindred caught directly in the beam takes 1 aggravated damage per turn and −2 dice to all actions. Fortitude (Defy Bane) reduces the damage.

generador-luz-solar.efecto: In the van. Lights up a 20-meter area. Inside it: 2 aggravated damage per turn and an automatic Terror Frenzy test (Difficulty 3) on entering. Takes two turns to power up.

gafas-termicas.efecto: Negate Obfuscate levels 1 and 2. Kindred show up as cold silhouettes, and that gives them away.

dron-termico.efecto: Sees the whole area and coordinates the team: +2 dice to their Awareness and ambush tests. Bringing it down: Strength + Athletics (Difficulty 4) with a thrown object, or a shot with Dexterity + Firearms (Difficulty 4).

bonos.condicion: the team coordinated by the drone

tiradas: @tirada{attributes.strength+skills.athletics|4|Bring down the drone with a thrown object: Strength + Athletics (Difficulty 4)}

camaras-corporales.efecto: Everything they see goes to Northline in real time. Each visible supernatural action in front of a camera: Thermometer +1 (maximum +2 per scene).

termometro.motivo: visible supernatural action in front of a body camera

fusil-corto-incendiario.efecto: Aggravated against Kindred (incendiary ammunition). Has a UV flashlight mounted on the weapon.
